title: MRR VerificationResult
description: docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2.13 (Review and VerificationResult): 'a review records judgment; a verification records checks.' Fourth task of Epic E3 (claim, evidence, correction kernel); the eleventh entity schema in this repository. The invariant this schema exists to serve is domain 2.13's own: 'a reviewer cannot satisfy independence if it shares the same execution principal and unaltered reasoning path as the producer' — the SELF-VERIFICATION PROHIBITION is AGENTS.md rule 8 ('No executor may approve or verify its own result') and this task's headline requirement (MRR-FR-070). This schema records the DECLARED independence profile and the verification's own findings; it does not itself validate that a declared profile is genuinely independent (that calculation, including 'repeated judgments from the same model/configuration MUST NOT count as independent', MRR-FR-076, is E3-T05 — out of this task's scope). Design decisions (task-packets/E3-T04.yaml derived_decisions): (1) no separate 'verification_id' field — like every sibling entity (Claim.id, SourceFamily.id, ...), the base object's own 'id' already names this record. (2) minted with URN entity 'verification' (not 'verification-result') to match the precedent schemas/claim.schema.json's own example/fixtures already set for the shape of a value in Claim.verification_ids ('urn:mrr:verification:...') before this schema existed — the URN entity segment has no registry enforcing a specific string (mrr.domain.identity._ENTITY_PATTERN accepts any '[a-z0-9-]+'), so this is a naming-consistency choice, not a structural requirement. (3) 'confidence' is a plain [0, 1] number — like source-family.schema.json's own 'confidence' field, this is documented as the REVIEWER's own confidence in their verification judgment, NOT a calibrated epistemic probability of anything (AGENTS.md prohibited-shortcuts: 'using an LLM confidence number as epistemic confidence') and NOT itself an independence weight. (4) 'findings[].severity' reuses correction-event.schema.json's exact three-value vocabulary (minor/material/critical) for consistency across this codebase's two 'severity' fields, rather than inventing a fourth vocabulary — domain 2.13 names 'findings by severity' without enumerating values of its own. (5) 'checks_performed' and 'conflicts_of_interest' are plain string arrays (domain 2.13 gives no further structure for either) — not a spec-derived vocabulary, flagged as an open question in this task's PR body, mirroring evidence-anchor.schema.json's own 'recomputation_status: not a specification-given vocabulary' precedent. (6) MRR-FR-072/MRR-FR-073 ('neither is left blank') are enforced by the two if/then conditionals below: a 'source' verification_type requires a non-empty evidence_inspected; a 'numeric' verification_type requires a non-null numeric_recomputation that itself records either a recomputed_value or an explicit impossible_reason (never neither) — mirroring evidence-anchor.schema.json's own 'exact resolution or explicit reason' if/then pattern. (7) The record carries no 'signature' field (domain 2.13 lists none) — like Claim and SourceFamily, its service persists plain create-only revisions; this schema and its service describe no update/mutate lifecycle at all, since domain 2.13 describes disagreement as SEPARATE records (MRR-FR-077), never as a revision of a prior one.

numericRecomputation.description: MRR-FR-073: 'Numeric verification MUST recompute the value or explicitly record why recomputation is impossible.' Present (non-null) whenever verification_type == 'numeric' (see the top-level if/then below); optional otherwise, since a source/skeptic/reproduction/other verification may have nothing numeric to recompute. The object variant always satisfies numericResolutionPresent: recomputed_value or impossible_reason must be non-null — never neither.

target_id.description: The claim, run, or artifact reviewed (domain 2.13: 'claim/run/artifact reviewed').

independence_profile.description: MRR-FR-071's exact six dimensions, ALL required: a record missing any one dimension fails validation. This records what the reviewer DECLARES; validating that the declaration is genuinely independent (same-model/prompt/etc. detection) is E3-T05, not this schema.

checks_performed.description: Free-text descriptions of the checks this verification actually ran (domain 2.13: 'checks performed'; no further structure given).

evidence_inspected.description: Evidence/anchors this verification retrieved or locally inspected (domain 2.13: 'evidence inspected'; MRR-FR-072 for verification_type == 'source').

confidence.description: The REVIEWER's own confidence in this verification's recommendation, in [0, 1] — not a calibrated epistemic probability of anything (see this schema's top-level description).

conflicts_of_interest.description: Free-text conflict-of-interest declarations; an empty array means none declared (domain 2.13: 'conflicts of interest').

adjudication_relation.description: When this record adjudicates a prior, conflicting review, the urn of the review it adjudicates (domain 2.13: 'adjudication relation'); null otherwise. Disagreement is preserved by recording SEPARATE VerificationResult objects (MRR-FR-077) — this field links them without either one being overwritten.
